articles.title: 30-Year Mystery Solved: 400 Gold Coins Found at Sea Belonged to Dutch Ship
articles.summary: Divers found 400 gold coins off Devon in 1995. After 30 years, historians identified the ship as the Dom van Keulen, a Dutch vessel carrying African gold.

articles.title: Arcy Drive’s ‘Attic Rock’ Is Taking the Music World by Storm
articles.summary: Arcy Drive, a four-piece from Long Island, calls their sound 'attic rock' — a blend of emo and garage rock. They've gone from playing covers to headlining festivals like Bonnaroo.

articles.title: Bob Dylan’s Last-Minute Guitarist Swap: A Chicago Bluesman Saves the Show
articles.summary: After two guitarists left Bob Dylan's band, Chicago blues guitarist Joel Paterson stepped in for a solo performance at a 5,000-seat amphitheater in Austin.
